excluded.name: DELTA NATIONAL FOREST - CAMPING
excluded.why: 56 reservable primitive sites spread along about 12 forest roads (FSR 703/707/715/720, Dummyline Road, the greentree reservoirs, Blue Lake and Little Sunflower River recreation areas) across a Wildlife Management Area, with potable water only at the ranger work center and no per-site coordinates. It is real, bookable, RV-length camping, but no single pin describes it; raised with AWH, and a Blue Lake Recreation Area entry would be the natural way in if he wants it
